message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration features a large stylized title "TEMPO" across the top in white, with a neon blue and red "EXIT" sign superimposed on the final "O." In the foreground, a man in a yellow jacket and dark pants is depicted mid-fall, slipping backward over a large, brown, metallic oil drum. His back is to the viewer as he flails his arms toward an open doorway. The drum lies horizontally on a checkered floor. 

To the right, another man stands calmly in a similar yellow jacket over a white shirt and dark pants, adjusting his lapels while looking toward the falling man with a slight smile. They are positioned within a room with high walls leading to a bright, open rectangular doorway. 

The image contains extensive Indonesian text. At the top left: "Balik Kanan Budiman Sudjatmiko H.24". Top right: "Risiko Pertamina Berburu Minyak Murah H.72". At the bottom left, large white text reads "TERGELINCIR MINYAK SAWIT" above a smaller paragraph mentioning "Airlangga Hartarto" and "Partai Golkar." The bottom right corner includes date, price, and barcode information.
